review_basis: Manual review of persisted first/root failing job logs, run titles, and repository ledger; aggregate summary/relay failures were excluded.

categories.reason: Stryker initial test execution failed deterministically before mutation scoring.
All three shards stopped on explicit unauthorized provider/cache errors; this is not attributed to a product defect or runner fault.
Repeatable composition, secret/config, health-wait, migration-fixture, cleanup, or release-harness failures; many runs are explicitly titled as successive CI/install fixes.
Grafana provisioning database locking and inconsistent migration terminal state surfaced in the runtime stack.
The latest-stable source had already acquired wallet-sync-state schema behavior that the fixture still expected to migrate. Incidental CoinGecko 429 warnings were not the failing assertion.
Missing Docker CLI, DIND/TLS work, runner-to-container archive deadlines, or host mount permission failures are explicit in the native logs.
The retained native job log shows the failing lane but omits or obscures the decisive nested diagnostic; no stronger attribution is claimed.

install.note: External price-provider HTTP 429 warnings appear in several container dumps but are incidental to explicit migration/fixture failures and are not counted as root causes.
